mapper.insert:
insert into basket_match_data_submission_team_stat (submission_id, match_id, season_id, stage_id, team_id, opponent_team_id, side_type, points, rebounds, offensive_rebounds, defensive_rebounds, assists, steals, blocks, turnovers, fouls, field_goals_made, field_goals_attempted, field_goal_pct, three_points_made, three_points_attempted, three_point_pct, free_throws_made, free_throws_attempted, free_throw_pct, possessions, efficiency, sort_no, create_time, update_time, is_delete) values
(#{item.submissionId}, #{item.matchId}, #{item.seasonId}, #{item.stageId}, #{item.teamId}, #{item.opponentTeamId}, #{item.sideType}, #{item.points}, #{item.rebounds}, #{item.offensiveRebounds}, #{item.defensiveRebounds}, #{item.assists}, #{item.steals}, #{item.blocks}, #{item.turnovers}, #{item.fouls}, #{item.fieldGoalsMade}, #{item.fieldGoalsAttempted}, #{item.fieldGoalPct}, #{item.threePointsMade}, #{item.threePointsAttempted}, #{item.threePointPct}, #{item.freeThrowsMade}, #{item.freeThrowsAttempted}, #{item.freeThrowPct}, #{item.possessions}, #{item.efficiency}, #{item.sortNo}, #{item.createTime}, #{item.updateTime}, #{item.isDelete})
mapper.select: select id, submission_id as submissionId, match_id as matchId, season_id as seasonId, stage_id as stageId, team_id as teamId, opponent_team_id as opponentTeamId, side_type as sideType, points, rebounds, offensive_rebounds as offensiveRebounds, defensive_rebounds as defensiveRebounds, assists, steals, blocks, turnovers, fouls, field_goals_made as fieldGoalsMade, field_goals_attempted as fieldGoalsAttempted, field_goal_pct as fieldGoalPct, three_points_made as threePointsMade, three_points_attempted as threePointsAttempted, three_point_pct as threePointPct, free_throws_made as freeThrowsMade, free_throws_attempted as freeThrowsAttempted, free_throw_pct as freeThrowPct, possessions, efficiency, sort_no as sortNo, create_time as createTime, update_time as updateTime, is_delete as isDelete from basket_match_data_submission_team_stat where submission_id = #{submissionId} and is_delete = 0 order by sort_no, id

select ts.team_id as teamId, t.team_name as teamName, ts.opponent_team_id as opponentTeamId, ot.team_name as opponentTeamName, ts.side_type as sideType, ts.points, ts.rebounds, ts.offensive_rebounds as offensiveRebounds, ts.defensive_rebounds as defensiveRebounds, ts.assists, ts.steals, ts.blocks, ts.turnovers, ts.fouls, ts.field_goals_made as fieldGoalsMade, ts.field_goals_attempted as fieldGoalsAttempted, ts.field_goal_pct as fieldGoalPct, ts.three_points_made as threePointsMade, ts.three_points_attempted as threePointsAttempted, ts.three_point_pct as threePointPct, ts.free_throws_made as freeThrowsMade, ts.free_throws_attempted as freeThrowsAttempted, ts.free_throw_pct as freeThrowPct, ts.possessions, ts.efficiency from basket_match_data_submission_team_stat ts left join basket_team t on t.id = ts.team_id and t.is_delete = 0 left join basket_team ot on ot.id = ts.opponent_team_id and ot.is_delete = 0 where ts.submission_id = #{submissionId} and ts.is_delete = 0 order by ts.sort_no, ts.id
